entities.name: A Seasonal Escape (Tswalu)
entities.headline: 4 nights, first night free
entities.travel_text: March to April and October to November
entities.conditions: Four nights with the first night complimentary, on set travel days (2027: Sunday and Thursday in, Thursday and Monday out). Not combinable.

entities.name: Atacama in Focus
entities.headline: Stay 5 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: 5 nights on the all-inclusive rate, with early check-in and late check-out when available. No buyouts or groups; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Bedwell Safari
entities.headline: Stay 7 nights, pay 6
entities.travel_text: Ongoing; dates confirmed when you book
entities.conditions: Minimum 7 nights. Includes one free night, a 60-minute massage per adult, a C$500 lodge credit, all dining and drinks and guided experiences. Per tent, two guests; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Best of Both Worlds: Lion Sands and Marataba (Marataba)
entities.headline: Free connecting flights with 3 nights at Marataba and 3 at Lion Sands
entities.conditions: Complimentary Federal Airlines flights between Marataba and Lion Sands via Johannesburg, same day in either direction, with three or more nights at Marataba and three or more at any Lion Sands lodge. Fuel levies of about US$20 to US$25 per sector are payable. Flights are weather dependent and routing may vary. Not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: CelebrateMORE (Marataba)
entities.headline: 25% off for honeymoons and milestone celebrations
entities.conditions: 25% off accommodation for the guest celebrating (honeymoon, babymoon, milestone anniversary or birthday) and their room-sharing partner. Three consecutive nights minimum. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability. Can be combined with Friends of MORE.

entities.name: Classic Huka
entities.headline: Stay 3 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: Minimum 3 nights. Includes one complimentary lunch, country breakfast, pre-dinner drinks and canapés, dinner with premium matched wines and return Taupō Airport transfers. Not available 18 Dec to 16 Jan; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Classic Longitude
entities.headline: Stay 3 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: Minimum 3 nights. Includes a A$100 lodge credit, a guided Uluru Base Walk, all dining and drinks (Champagne included) and return airport transfers. Not available 22 Dec to 4 Jan; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Classic Louise
entities.headline: Stay 3 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: Minimum 3 nights. Includes a A$100 lodge credit, daily breakfast, pre-dinner drinks and a matched-wine dinner. Not available 24 Dec to 2 Jan; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Classic SOL
entities.headline: Stay 3 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: Minimum 3 nights. Includes a A$100 lodge credit, all dining and drinks (premium wines and spirits), signature guided experiences and return airport transfers. Not available 18 Dec to 16 Jan; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Classic Silky
entities.headline: Stay 3 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: Minimum 3 nights. Includes a A$100 lodge credit, daily breakfast and matched-wine dinner, an evening drinks hour, daily yoga and a daily Port Douglas shuttle. Not available 22 Dec to 4 Jan; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: DiscoverMORE (Marataba)
entities.headline: 10% off when you combine two MORE lodges
entities.conditions: 10% off accommodation at each property when at least two MORE Collection properties are booked on one trip. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability. Not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Friends of MORE (Marataba)
entities.headline: 10% off for returning MORE guests and their companions
entities.conditions: 10% off accommodation for guests who have stayed with MORE Collection before, and the friends and family travelling with them. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability. Can be combined with StayMORE and CelebrateMORE.

entities.name: Patagonia in Focus
entities.headline: Stay 5 nights, save 10%
entities.conditions: 5 nights including all dining and open bar, daily excursions and airport transfers, with early or late check-out when available. No buyouts or groups.

entities.name: Signature Longitude
entities.headline: Stay 4 nights, save 10%
entities.travel_text: Ongoing; dates confirmed when you book
entities.conditions: Minimum 4 nights. Includes a A$250 scenic flight credit per tent, a A$100 lodge credit, private Dune Top dining, a guided Uluru Base Walk, all dining and drinks (French Champagne included) and return Ayers Rock Airport transfers. Flight and lodge credits cannot be combined; not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Signature Silky
entities.headline: Stay 4 nights, save 10%
entities.travel_text: Ongoing; dates confirmed when you book
entities.conditions: Minimum 4 nights. Includes French Champagne on arrival, a A$200 lodge credit, daily breakfast and matched-wine dinner in the Treehouse, an evening drinks hour, daily open-air yoga and a daily return shuttle to Port Douglas. Not combinable with other offers.

entities.name: Spirit of Chile (Atacama)
entities.headline: Stay 7 nights, save 20%
entities.conditions: 7+ nights across Tierra Atacama and Tierra Patagonia within 30 days, at least 3 nights per lodge. Includes a room upgrade and early check-in or late check-out when available. No extra-person or group bookings.

entities.name: Spirit of Chile (Patagonia)
entities.headline: Stay 7 nights, save 20%
entities.conditions: 7+ nights across Tierra Patagonia and Tierra Atacama within 30 days, at least 3 nights per lodge. Includes a room upgrade, all dining and open bar, daily excursions and airport transfers. No extra-person, group or partner-hotel bookings.

entities.name: Stay 7, Pay 5 (Tswalu)
entities.headline: Stay 7 nights, pay 5
entities.travel_text: 4 January to 31 May and 1 September to 17 December 2027
entities.conditions: Seven nights with two complimentary. Tarkuni as one seven-night sole-use stay. Not combinable.

entities.name: Stay Longer for Less (Tswalu)
entities.headline: Stay 5 nights, pay 4
entities.conditions: Five nights with one complimentary night (2026: fifth night free when booking four). Not combinable; request at booking.

entities.name: StayMORE (Marataba)
entities.headline: Stay 4 nights, pay 3
entities.conditions: Four consecutive nights required. Safari Lodge and Mountain Lodge only; Marataba Villa is excluded. Up to 5 rooms or 10 guests. Subject to availability. Can be combined with Friends of MORE.

entities.name: Visit Year-Round (Tswalu)
entities.headline: Stay 4 nights, half off the first
entities.conditions: Four nights or more with 50% off the first night. Not combinable with other offers; must be requested at booking.
